Always overwrite every unrequested higher discovery level with a fresh `{passed: false, status: NOT_RUN, version: null, discovery: null}` receipt. A prior invoked pass must not survive a later loaded-only verification. Keep status VERIFIED when the requested level meets the sealed target minimum and every required check passes. Add a test that verifies invoked first, verifies loaded second on the same manifest, then proves invoked is NOT_RUN and not passed.
8|
9|FINDING B, EXECUTABLE SCHEMA/TEMPLATE CONTRACT: add a standard-library `validate_contract_artifacts(schema_path, template_path)` function in scripts/implant_skill.py. It must fail `SCHEMA_PARITY_MISMATCH` for schema divergence and `TEMPLATE_PARITY_MISMATCH` for template divergence. Validate structural parity between Python constants/validators and assets/implant-manifest.schema.json, including: top-level required keys; schema version; plan status enum; plan/target required keys; target methods; collision actions; discovery levels; adapter required keys; hash patterns; rollback fields; and conditional pathState requirements for link_target, directory tree_sha256, and file sha256. Update the JSON schema to encode those conditional requirements with `$defs.pathState.allOf` if/then blocks. Validate the template's top-level, source, scope, compatibility, target, adapter, and rollback key sets against build_plan's accepted request shape, including rollback.backup_root. Call default artifact validation from both inspect_request and load_and_validate_manifest so every CLI phase enforces the published contract. The standalone validate_implant_manifest.py must also enforce it. Add unit tests that: accept the shipped artifacts; reject a weakened schema with pathState.allOf removed; reject a drifted template; and materialize the shipped template with temporary real paths/commands then pass it through build_plan successfully. Do not add a third-party JSON Schema dependency or pretend to implement all of JSON Schema.
10|
11|FINDING C, SOURCE/TARGET OVERLAP: inspect and manifest validation must fail `SOURCE_TARGET_OVERLAP` whenever either target.destination or target.effective_destination is the canonical source path, an ancestor of it, or a descendant of it. Use resolved absolute path relationships so symlinked ancestors cannot bypass the guard. Enforce this in build_plan before prior-state capture and again in _validate_plan_shape. Cover same-path REPLACE, same-path RENAME, source-ancestor REPLACE, and source-descendant target cases. No manifest may be written for a rejected request. Preserve the canonical source bytes.
12|
13|AUTHORITATIVE CHECKER: /mnt/d_drive/repos/ringer/work/cross-harness-skill-implant/check_implant_workflow.py already contains red cases for a narrowed verify, weakened schema, and same/ancestor/descendant overlap. Do not edit it.
14|
15|RUN FROM REPO ROOT: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`; `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/ringer/work/cross-harness-skill-implant/check_implant_workflow.py --repo .`; `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/skill-implant-final-repair-pyc python3 -m py_compile scripts/implant_skill.py scripts/validate_implant_manifest.py`. All must exit 0. Then perform one bounded self-audit without launching nested model workers, update operator docs only where behavior changed, and write notes.md with files changed, exact tests/counts, findings closed, and residual risks. Do not claim live promotion.
16|
